We've no more goals to give you so we're scarpering, have fun! :)

Try pressing [shift]+[alt]+[x] (default) to enabled debug mode, this is mainly useful for getting XYZ coords of any give map cell. This is intended just for the devs and modders so don't bother reporting issues you have with it, you'll just get ignored

Try pressing [shift]+[alt]+[z] (default) to enabled developer mode, this is mainly useful for trying out ideas... or at least turning off that poxy fog XD. This is intended just for the devs and modders so don't bother reporting issues you have with it, you'll just get ignored
Try holding [tab] (default) once you've placed some storage, it's an easy way to see what is storing what. You can even click on their icons to change what they store :D
To help you get started we've a bunch of goals for you to fulfill
Try holding [x] (default) for the ruler overlay
Build some Dams as far downstream as you can, pick the spot that uses at least as many slots as there are water sources feeding your river to prevent flooding
Build decor on/near your housing to maximise it's effect on your cologny's wellbeing
Build a Hangout or two for beavers to socialise in, don't want them to become introverts like us now do we? XD
Build Medical Beds ready to take injured beavers
Lower the work hours now so that beavers have time to fill pods and/or uh, 'dote' on each other
Get haulers to do the leg work
Remove some land from your way
Start producing Equipment often used to remove land
Start collecting Volatiles often used to remove land
Increase the number of haulers allowed to work here so that your cologny runs smoother
It's time to increase your beavers, you're gonna need them soon
Collect more water to outpace water consumption and fill those tanks
A few small tanks won't be enough for your growing cologny, build bigger storage then replace the old storage
Mark which trees you want your Lumberjacks to cut down, we suggest leaving those on the edge of greenland (away from the river) alone, you'll need them to spawn new ones until you can plant them
Pop down a Gatherer to start gathering the available berries
Pop down a couple of Lumberjack Flags to start logging with
Pop down a Water Pump ready to build when you resume game play
At the cost of more consumption and lower life expetancy, raise the working hours for now. You'll find it in the top right
Here you'll find what work is being done by who in the district. If no District Center is selected then it will display all districts
Let's select a beaver by clicking it
Here you'll find your selected beaver's needs, life expetancy and other details
Here you'll find the average state of your selected district's needs, if no District Center are selected then it'll show the average of all districts
Start by pausing the game if you haven't already done so
You can resume with the same key you paused but you can also resume while adjusting how much Timberborn tries to cram into a single second using >>>, >> and >. Give them a try
